summary: `scenario_report.py --plan <test-plan.md>` audits exactly the scenarios an approved Test Plan defines under its `<story-id>-TS-###` headings and the qualified AC/BR identities their `source_refs` cite, read with the backlog compiler's Test Plan grammar. A scenario or rule of another story that a plan only names in prose, such as a Given clause or a supersession note, no longer becomes a NO-TEST row that fails the plan's own audit. A dependent Item passes its dependencies' approved Test Plans as further `--plan` values and names each dependency scenario its own plan supersedes with `--superseded`. The QA skill and its coverage-audit reference now run the audit with `--plan`; `--brief` keeps its output for an explicit id list.
